proposals.name: Causal-memory kernel uniqueness / CMF classification (multiple independent proof routes)

statement.latest: Any kernel K satisfying causality(P1)+passivity(P2)+finite-order recurrence(H2) is a Completely-Monotone-Finite-resource (CMF) superposition of geometric-decay channels K(n)=sum_k w_k*r_k^n, w_k>=0, 0<r_k<1, certified via Bernstein's theorem/alternating-difference test plus a positive-real (passivity) PSD factorization; the single-exponential-channel special case G(tau)=(D/tau_c)e^{-tau/tau_c} is independently forced by (a) a finite-dimensional local Hamiltonian plus a Lieb-Robinson locality bound, (b) a Laplace-transform + Paley-Wiener causality argument with a Planck-scale lower bound on tau_c, and (c) a direct axiomatic characterization proving the telegraph PDE is the unique linear second-order class member satisfying finite propagation speed, dissipative stability, and source-freedom.

parents.evidence: CMC/P.06.v1 (cattaneo_telegraph_closure_witness) already certifies closure for the single-channel Cattaneo/telegraph case; this merged object proves the fully general statement (CMF superposition, part 1: 18212478/18757034/18210933) and a matching axiomatic uniqueness-among-a-class theorem (part 2: 18065304/18051281/18013670), of which the single-channel Cattaneo case is one instance -- the closure witness only certifies membership, not this characterization/uniqueness-among-a-class result.

weld/M.01.v1's root weld postulates that retained distinction forces the finite causal graph/stepper abstractly; part 2 (18013670 Theorem T1) supplies a genuinely new microscopic derivation route -- a finite-dimensional local Hamiltonian plus a Lieb-Robinson bound forcing exactly the single-pole exponential kernel -- a primitive (Lieb-Robinson velocity, many-body locality bound) the root does not carry on its own.

EQ-001/P.35.v1 only asserts the telegraph process is 'derived from finite retention, not inserted' without a uniqueness proof; part 3 (17890616/17901698/17926609/17899050 Theorem 1.1) supplies an actual kernel-uniqueness argument (Laplace-transform + Lieb-Robinson locality + Paley-Wiener causality) forcing the single-pole exponential kernel, plus a Planck-scale lower bound on tau_c.

proposals.name: Telegraph-to-Klein-Gordon dephasing map and derived mass-memory identity (with renormalisation-stability extension)

statement.latest: Dephasing substitution s(x,t)=e^{-t/(2 tau_c)}*psi(x,t) turns the registered telegraph equation into a Klein-Gordon-type field equation d^2psi/dt^2 - c^2*Laplacian(psi) + psi/(4 tau_c^2) = 0, identifying a derived mass m_eff = hbar/(2 c^2 tau_c) (equivalently m=1/(2 tau_c) in natural units), corroborated by ten independent routes (uncertainty, Zitterbewegung, Compton time, Margolus-Levitin, ...); a companion order-exclusion uniqueness lemma (only quadratic-order-or-lower PDEs survive) and a one-loop renormalisation-stability sketch argue the derived mass gap survives minimal gauge coupling in phi^4/Yukawa/QED/QCD/Yang-Mills completions.

parents.evidence: EQ-001/P.62.v1 states verbatim that retention memory is 'declared (not derived) as playing a mass-like role; no mass-energy law is derived from the root.' This merged object supplies exactly that missing derivation via the dephasing substitution, giving m=hbar/(2 c^2 tau_c) as a derived (not merely declared) consequence, with independent corroborating routes and a renormalisation-stability argument for the resulting mass gap -- all as a proposed derivation route, not yet independently machine-checked.
